title: National Quality Framework for childcare in WA: the seven-month delay, with monthly and quarterly data

outcomes.label: Childcare-named businesses' share of named-business ABN cancellations (%)
outcomes.source: data/processed/abr_abn (ABN Bulk Extract, 14 Oct 2026; industry inferred from business names)
outcomes.unit: WA vs the other seven jurisdictions pooled
outcomes.estimator: on-off difference-in-differences (alicia.evaluate.stagger): pooled, early and late

placebo_pools.rule: named industries outside divisions P and Q with 10-150 WA cancellations a year (2009-2011)
childcare itself at fake dates: the same windows shifted back 2 or more whole years, whole window before January 2012

outcomes.label: 100 x log(Child care CPI / All groups CPI), Perth vs the other capitals
outcomes.estimator: on-off difference-in-differences; detrended variant required (decision E-31)

placebo_pools.rule: CPI classes outside Domestic and household services
childcare itself at fake dates: the same windows shifted back 2 or more whole years, whole window before January 2012

notes: Kept as a primary because it is the only outcome precise enough to detect a plausible effect; it does not set the verdict.

outcomes.label: Childcare-named share of ABNs active since each month (survivors)
outcomes.measure: share of active ABNs by start month
outcomes.unit: WA vs the other seven jurisdictions pooled

placebo_pools.rule: childcare itself at fake dates: the same windows shifted back 2 or more whole years, whole window before January 2012

outcomes.label: Hours actually worked, ANZSIC group 871 Child care services
outcomes.unit: WA vs the other seven jurisdictions pooled

placebo_pools.rule: ANZSIC groups with 4,000-25,000 WA workers (2009-2011), outside P and Q
childcare itself at fake dates: the same windows shifted back 2 or more whole years, whole window before January 2012

outcomes.label: Employed persons, ANZSIC group 871
outcomes.unit: WA vs the other seven jurisdictions pooled

placebo_pools.rule: childcare itself at fake dates: the same windows shifted back 2 or more whole years, whole window before January 2012

notes: Windows: pre [pre_start, t1), on [t1, t2), off [t2, end]; quarter starts for quarterly outcomes.
fake_years is a half-open range of whole-year shifts.
